title: THE CAMERA ZOOMS OUT WHEN YOU SPRINT
why: His answer 43: the camera should zoom out a little while you sprint, as a setting. Sprinting now pulls the camera back about seven percent, so a little more of the street shows, and it eases in and out with the sprint in the same way the scope eases. It is a row in DISPLAY, SPRINT ZOOM-OUT, ON by default; OFF holds the camera where it was. The view is all that changes: speed, noise, aim and damage are untouched.
now: The camera now pulls back a little while you sprint. Settings has a SPRINT ZOOM-OUT row in DISPLAY.
